I'm so sorry about that — I can see that order TR-4526 has been marked as lost in transit by the carrier. 

Because of this, it's treated as a lost-parcel claim rather than a standard delay. I've passed your details to a colleague who will sort out either a free replacement or a full refund (whichever you prefer) within 5 business days. Your reference number is **ESC-TR-4526-05120000**.
